review.reason: The original test requires the vulnerable Limit=0 and HTTP 500 behavior, then fails unconditionally, so a repaired implementation cannot pass. The replacement inverts that malformed oracle: the omitted request must reach PerformanceEvidence and EvidencePage with the product-owned bounded default, return HTTP 200 with the retained evidence, and remain comparable to an independently successful Limit=1 control. Separate subtests preserve independent execution. The frozen before run shows only the omitted-default assertions failing while the bounded control passes; the repaired run passes every subtest.

assertions.passing_condition: A request to the advertised evidence URL with no limit query parameter reaches PerformanceEvidence and EvidencePage with sprint.DefaultPerformanceLimits().EvidencePageSize, returns HTTP 200 and the retained evidence record, while an explicit bounded Limit=1 invocation independently remains successful.
